en.headline: Korean illustration brands gather for limited pop-up at D2 Place in Lai Chi Kok
en.dek: The neomu neomu pop-up brings eight Korean illustration brands, several making their Hong Kong debut, to D2 Place TWO until 22 November with plush toys, charms and stationery.
body: A Korean cultural creative pop-up titled neomu neomu has opened at Shop P2P on the ground floor of D2 Place TWO in Lai Chi Kok, running through 22 November.

The organisers said the store brings together eight Korean illustration brands, including several appearing in Hong Kong for the first time, offering plush toys, charms, blind-box figures, phone accessories, postcards, stickers and other lifestyle items.

Character standees are available for photographs and a gift is offered with purchases while stocks last. The pop-up operates daily from noon to 8pm, organised with partners including KOTRA Hong Kong and D2 Place.
The event is one of several short-run creative retail displays currently on in Hong Kong, alongside design festivals and other limited installations.

zh.headline: 韓國插畫品牌期間限定店登陸荔枝角D2 Place
zh.dek: neomu neomu韓國文創快閃店匯集八個韓國插畫品牌，部分首次來港，於荔枝角D2 Place二期地下展至11月22日，售賣毛絨玩具及文具。
body: 名為neomu neomu的韓國文創期間限定店已於荔枝角D2 Place二期地下P2P舖開幕，展期至11月22日。
主辦單位表示，店舖集合八個韓國插畫品牌，包括多個首次在香港亮相的品牌，提供毛絨玩具、吊飾、盲盒公仔、手機配件、明信片、貼紙及其他生活用品。
店內設有角色立牌可供拍照，購物可獲贈品，數量有限，送完即止。快閃店每日中午12時至晚上8時開放，合作夥伴包括KOTRA香港及D2 Place。
這是香港目前多個短期創意零售活動之一，與設計節及其他限定裝置同期舉行。
